title: b7z9.36(a): Python — /.well-known/capability-announce resource + bounded LRU capability table
description: Child of b7z9.36 (spec 06-security.md:949-1008). Build the Python system layer on the existing crypto oracle (lichen/crypto/capability_announcements.py verify_capability_announcement, 30 tests + test/vectors/capability_announcements.json): (1) a bounded capability table keyed by announcer_iid — 256 entries, LRU eviction, MAY reserve 25% for egress (make the reservation a constant); (2) a POST /.well-known/capability-announce resource in python/src/lichen/coap/resources: OSCORE-authenticated (mirror the deaddrop resource's auth pattern), decode COSE_Sign1 from the CBOR payload, resolve the announcer pubkey from the link-authenticated sender, verify_capability_announcement with cached_seq from the table, 2.04 on success / 4.03 on failure (kid mismatch, verification failure, replay); (3) tests: valid announce cached, replay rejected, expiry rejected, kid mismatch 4.03, LRU eviction at capacity.
